skill.name: outreach-manager
skill.description: Use when the user asks to write influencer outreach, follow up with a creator, or negotiate partnership terms. Produces personalized pitches, multi-touch follow-up sequences, negotiation scripts, objection handling, and outreach pipeline tracking. Not for final signed agreements; use contract-helper.

content.value_statement: Creator outreach often fails when messages are generic, poorly timed, or hard to track. This skill creates personalized pitches, follow-up cadences, negotiation scripts, and pipeline views for creator partnerships.
actual_capabilities: Drafts personalized first-touch creator pitches using campaign and audience context.
Produces DM, email, and management-facing message variations.
Builds four-touch follow-up cadences with timing and softer calls to action.
Creates negotiation scripts for rate gaps, scope changes, and objection handling.
Tracks outreach pipeline stages, next actions, and conversion rates.
Prepares handoff summaries for content review or contract finalization.
limitations: It depends on user-supplied creator, brand, budget, and campaign facts.
It does not verify creator identity, audience quality, or pricing data by itself.
It does not send messages or update CRMs without a separate connector.
It does not create legally binding agreements; use a contract workflow.

use_cases.title: Launch a Creator Campaign
use_cases.description: Prepare tailored outreach for a list of creators, including message variants, follow-up timing, and next actions.

use_cases.title: Negotiate Within Budget
use_cases.description: Turn a creator rate gap into clear options for scope changes, value exchange, or future partnership incentives.

use_cases.title: Track Agency Outreach
use_cases.description: Summarize contacted creators, response stages, open objections, due follow-ups, and confirmed partnership handoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a First Message
prompt_templates.prompt: Use outreach-manager to write a first DM for @[handle] on [platform]. The campaign is [campaign], the offer is [compensation], and the deliverables are [deliverables].

prompt_templates.title: Create Follow-Ups
prompt_templates.prompt: Use outreach-manager to build a four-touch follow-up sequence for creators who have not replied. Include timing, message length, channel, and a soft final close.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a Rate Gap
prompt_templates.prompt: Use outreach-manager to negotiate with @[handle]. Their ask is $[creator ask], our budget is $[budget], and we can adjust [scope or value options].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use outreach-manager to create outreach copy, follow-ups, negotiation notes, and a pipeline tracker for these creators: [creator list]. Include status, next action, due date, and handoff notes.

output_examples.input: A skincare brand wants to contact an eco-lifestyle creator for a sponsored launch.
output_examples.output: The skill returns personalization points, a concise first message, DM and email variants, and a follow-up plan for the next two weeks.

output_examples.input: A creator asks for more than the campaign budget allows.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a rate-gap summary, three negotiation paths, ready-to-send scripts, and responses to common objections.

output_examples.input: An agency needs to manage outreach for ten creators.
output_examples.output: The skill returns stage counts, per-creator status, prioritized actions for today, and notes for confirmed partner handoff.

best_practices: Provide real creator details, recent content references, deliverables, budget, and timing before drafting messages.
Use short first-touch messages and make the first ask easy to decline or continue.
Update the pipeline after every reply, follow-up, rate change, or confirmed handoff.
anti_patterns: Do not invent creator metrics, testimonials, past results, or content references.
Do not send identical follow-ups or daily reminders to non-responders.
Do not use this skill to finalize contract language or legal terms.

faq.question: Can this skill send messages for me?
faq.answer: No. It drafts outreach and plans timing. Sending requires your manual action or a separate approved connector.

faq.question: Does it work for both email and direct messages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create short DM versions, fuller email versions, and management-facing outreach.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide creator handles, platform, niche, recent content, campaign goal, offer, budget, deliverables, and timeline.

faq.question: Can it help with creator negotiation?
faq.answer: Yes. It prepares scripts for rate gaps, scope changes, value exchange, future work, and common objections.

faq.question: Does it replace a CRM?
faq.answer: No. It creates pipeline tables and next actions, but a CRM remains the system of record when available.

faq.question: Is it suitable for legal agreements?
faq.answer: No. Use it before agreement drafting. Final contracts should go through a contract workflow and legal review.
